entry.content: • (Database Migration) Made --auto-commit flag the default for gcloud database-migration conversion-workspaces seed|convert|import-rules operations. To disable auto-committing, use --no-auto-commit flag.
entry.summary: The `--auto-commit` flag is now the default for several database migration operations, including `seed`, `convert`, and `import-rules`. To disable this behavior, use the `--no-auto-commit` flag.
entry.title: Breaking Changes: Database Migration: Auto-commit is now default

entry.content:
• Fixed an issue where running gcloud init crashed when Enterprise Certificate Proxy (ECP) binaries were missing from configuration.
  • Updated macOS Python Virtualenv for the gcloud CLI to 3.14.6.
entry.summary: The gcloud CLI has been updated to fix a crash when running gcloud init with missing Enterprise Certificate Proxy binaries. The macOS Python Virtualenv for the gcloud CLI has also been updated.
entry.title: Google Cloud CLI: gcloud init crash fixed

entry.content: • Promote AlloyDB Backup DR restore flags (--backupdr-backup and --backupdr-data-source) to the GA track.
entry.summary: We are promoting the AlloyDB Backup DR restore flags, `--backupdr-backup` and `--backupdr-data-source`, to the GA track. This means these features are now fully supported and recommended for production use.
entry.title: AlloyDB: AlloyDB Backup DR restore flags now generally available

entry.content: • Fixed a bug where gcloud biglake iceberg tables commands failed to send the X-Iceberg-Access-Delegation: vended-credentials header.
entry.summary: A bug has been fixed in BigLake where certain `gcloud` commands were not sending the correct header for Iceberg table access. This resolves an issue that prevented these commands from functioning correctly.
entry.title: BigLake: BigLake command fix

entry.content:
• Added -f/--force support to bq rm --connection to ignore NOT_FOUND errors if the connection does not exist.
  • Fixed reading configuration from gcloud CLI with --nouse_google_auth flag.
  • Added a predefined label for jobs created in specific metrics environments.
  • Updated the help text for several global flags.
  • Updated command format in the user-agent HTTP header of API requests.
entry.summary: The BigQuery command-line tool has been updated with new features, including force deletion for connections, improved configuration reading, predefined job labels, and updated help text and API request formatting.
entry.title: BigQuery: BigQuery CLI improvements

entry.content: • Added --log-retention-days flag across gcloud backup-dr backup-plans create and update across all release tracks to enable Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) log retention configuration.
entry.summary: You can now configure log retention for point-in-time recovery with the new --log-retention-days flag. This flag is available for backup plans during creation and update across all release tracks.
entry.title: Cloud Backup DR: Configure backup log retention

entry.content:
• Added --ignore-warnings flag to gcloud bigtable instances tables update and gcloud bigtable tables update.
  • Promoted --ignore-warnings flag of gcloud bigtable materialized-views create to GA.
entry.summary: You can now use the `--ignore-warnings` flag with `gcloud bigtable instances tables update` and `gcloud bigtable tables update` commands. The `--ignore-warnings` flag for creating materialized views is now generally available.
entry.title: Cloud Bigtable: Bigtable: ignore warnings in table updates and materialized views

entry.content: • Enabled Airflow CLI commands for Composer environments running Airflow 3.2.
entry.summary: You can now use Airflow CLI commands directly with your Composer environments running Airflow 3.2. This provides greater flexibility and control over your workflows.
entry.title: Cloud Composer: Airflow CLI commands now available for Composer

entry.content: • Promoted enabled-for-users-groups option for --scim-usage flag to beta in gcloud beta iam workforce-pools providers.
entry.summary: The `enabled-for-users-groups` option for the `--scim-usage` flag in `gcloud beta iam workforce-pools providers` has been promoted to beta. This enhancement improves SCIM provisioning capabilities within Cloud IAM.
entry.title: Cloud IAM: Cloud IAM SCIM Usage Beta

entry.content: • Added --sandbox-launcher flag to gcloud beta run jobs and gcloud beta run worker-pools command groups to allow setting a container as sandbox launcher when creating or updating a Cloud Run job or a worker pool.
entry.summary: You can now specify a custom container as a sandbox launcher for Cloud Run jobs and worker pools using the new `--sandbox-launcher` flag. This allows for greater control over the sandbox environment for your workloads.
entry.title: Cloud Run: Run jobs with custom sandbox launcher

entry.content: • Added --idle-action flag to gcloud alpha workstations configs create, gcloud alpha workstations configs update, gcloud beta workstations configs create, and gcloud beta workstations configs update commands.
entry.summary: New flags allow you to configure actions for Cloud Workstations when they are idle. This helps manage resources efficiently by automatically stopping or restarting workstations based on inactivity.
entry.title: Cloud Workstations: Cloud Workstations idle action flag

entry.content:
• Added --network-tier flag to gcloud compute public-advertised-prefixes create in beta.
  • Added --metadata-filter flag to gcloud compute forwarding-rules create command across all release tracks.
  • Added --metadata-filter flag to gcloud compute forwarding-rules update commands across all release tracks.
  • Added gcloud compute machine-images test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine machine image in beta, preview, and GA.
  • Promoted regex_rewrite support in url_rewrite block to beta for gcloud compute url-maps.
  • Promoted the following gcloud compute routers command groups to GA: add-named-set, add-named-set-element, download-named-set, get-named-set, list-named-sets, remove-named-set, remove-named-set-element, and upload-named-set.
  • Added gcloud compute health-sources test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a health source.
  • Added gcloud compute instant-snapshot-groups set-iam-policy command to set the IAM policy for a Compute Engine instant snapshot group.
  • Added gcloud compute networks subnets test-iam-permissions command in beta, preview, and GA.
  • Added gcloud compute image-views describe command in beta.
  • Added gcloud compute snapshots test-iam-permissions to test IAM permissions for Compute Engine snapshots.
  • Added gcloud compute interconnects attachments groups set-iam-policy command to set IAM policy on an interconnect attachment group in beta, preview, and GA.
  • Added --internal-range flag to gcloud compute addresses create to support allocating global internal IP addresses from an Internal Range for Private Service Connect.
  • Updated gcloud compute reservations hosts list and gcloud compute reservations hosts describe to require --reservation when --reservation-block is specified.
entry.summary: This update introduces new flags for network tiers and metadata filtering, along with enhanced IAM permission testing for various Compute Engine resources. It also includes advancements in machine images, URL rewrite capabilities, and the promotion of several router command groups to general availability. Additionally, new commands for managing health sources and instant snapshot groups are now available.
entry.title: Compute Engine: New Compute Engine features and updates

entry.content: • Updated gcloud beta developer-connect account-connectors commands to support Bring Your Own (BYO) and Bitbucket Cloud (BBC) connection types.
entry.summary: New options for connecting your development accounts are now available. The `gcloud beta developer-connect account-connectors` commands have been updated to support Bring Your Own (BYO) and Bitbucket Cloud (BBC) connection types, offering greater flexibility for your development workflows.
entry.title: Developer Connect: Developer Connect Enhancements

entry.content: • Promoted --view, --memberships, --filter, and --sort-by flags on gcloud container fleet|hub config-management describe command to beta.
entry.summary: The `--view`, `--memberships`, `--filter`, and `--sort-by` flags for the `gcloud container fleet config-management describe` command have been promoted to beta. This update enhances the command's capabilities for managing fleet configurations.
entry.title: GKE Hub: Fleet config management flags promoted to beta

entry.summary: A new flag, `--source-dms-private-connection`, has been added to `gcloud network-management connectivity-tests`. This enhancement allows for more specific configuration of connectivity tests, particularly when dealing with private connections.
entry.title: Network Management: New flag for connectivity tests

entry.content:
• Added the --secret-type flag to gcloud secrets create to support creating secrets of different types (e.g. Cloud SQL credentials).
  • Added the gcloud secrets enable-managed-rotation command to enable managed rotation for a secret using Cloud SQL credentials.
  • Added the gcloud secrets rotate-secret command to rotate a secret.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.
entry.summary: New features for secret management have been released, including support for different secret types with the `--secret-type` flag, enabling managed rotation for secrets like Cloud SQL credentials, and a new command to rotate secrets. You can subscribe to release notes for more updates.
entry.title: Secret Manager: New secret management features
